title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 277 (Ledger, Debtor Prioritization & Stock Restock)
highlights: Customer Accounts & Debtor Auto-Prioritization: Pending due customers automatically sorted to the top with outstanding badges and fast ledger access.
Product Master Stock Edit & Quick Restock: Unlocked direct stock adjustments in Product Master and one-click quick restock from low stock reorder tab.
3D Vector Celebration Animations: 60-FPS animated celebration banners with audio for festivals & shop owner birthdays.
Seamless Platform Isolation: Windows Desktop updates independently from Android without cross-platform update conflicts.
Zero-Overflow Display Scaling: Perfectly rendered dialogs and tables across all Windows Display Scaling factors (100%, 125%, 150%).
fixes: Integrated Android PackageInstaller with FileProvider for seamless in-app APK installation.
Enabled stock editing in Product Master and added audit-logged stock adjustments.
Added Customer Ledger icon and popup menu to Customer Master cards.
Fixed horizontal action bar clipping and dialog title vertical wrap on display zoom.
